title: An archimedean ordered group embeds in the reals
statement: Let $\Gamma$ be a totally ordered abelian additive group [def-trf-totally-ordered-abelian-group] which is Archimedean, meaning that for every $a\in\Gamma$ and every $b>0$ there exists $n\in\mathbf N$ with $a\le nb$. Then there exists an injective order-preserving additive monoid homomorphism $\Gamma\to\mathbf R$.
